plan_review.notes: Independent design review required panel-space drag deltas, scene-level panel hit testing, and input reset on panel transitions; all were incorporated.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly implements touch scrolling for the achievements panel. It properly calculates drag deltas, tracks dragged state to prevent accidental clicks when finishing a drag, and gracefully resets inputs at the scene level when the panel becomes visible. Scope discipline is excellent, focusing entirely on the requested feature. The test coverage is robust, successfully employing CDP to simulate touch gestures and validating that the game simulation (player movement) is appropriately halted while scrolling.
